post.caption:
One of these eight planets spins backwards. Here's what makes every single one strange.

One science fact a day. Follow so you don't miss tomorrow's.

#planets #solarsystem #space #astronomy #science #venus #jupiter #saturn #sciencefacts #didyouknow

subject_anchor: the solar system and the people who study it: planets, moons, orbits, telescopes, star charts, the night sky
style_lock: minimal black ink doodle illustration, thin uniform line weight, simple stick-figure and flat-shape style, no shading, no gradients, no colour except black lines, plain off-white paper background #F2EDE4, generous white space, centred composition, hand-drawn cartoon feel

beats.text: One of these planets spins backwards.
beats.image_prompt: a single doodle planet with a circular arrow curving the wrong way around it, a small stick figure below scratching its head

beats.text: Eight planets. Here is what makes each one strange.
beats.image_prompt: eight small doodle circles of increasing size in a row across the page, a tiny sun doodle at the far left

beats.text: Mercury has no atmosphere, so its sky is always black.
beats.image_prompt: a small cratered doodle planet with a black square of sky above it dotted with tiny stars

beats.text: Venus spins backwards, and a day there lasts longer than its year.
beats.image_prompt: a doodle planet with a reversed circular arrow around it and a small doodle clock beside it

beats.text: Earth is the only place we have ever found life.
beats.image_prompt: a doodle globe with simple continent shapes and one tiny stick figure standing on top waving

beats.text: Mars is red because its soil is basically rust.
beats.image_prompt: a doodle planet with hatched shading, a small doodle rover with wheels beside it leaving tracks

beats.text: Jupiter's great red spot is a storm wider than Earth.
beats.image_prompt: a large doodle planet with horizontal stripes and one big spiral swirl, a tiny circle next to it for scale

beats.text: Saturn is so light it would float in water.
beats.image_prompt: a doodle ringed planet bobbing in a simple doodle bathtub with wavy water lines

beats.text: Uranus is tipped on its side, rolling around the sun.
beats.image_prompt: a doodle planet with vertical rings, tilted sideways, a dashed orbit line curving around it

beats.text: And on Neptune, the wind blows faster than the speed of sound.
beats.image_prompt: a doodle planet with long horizontal speed lines streaking off one side, a tiny stick figure holding onto its hat

beats.text: Follow for one fact a day.
beats.image_prompt: a stick figure holding up a blank hand-drawn sign, plenty of empty space above it
